targets.title: Storybook rules
targets.description: Rules for writing Storybook stories and interaction tests for React components in CSF Next: how to query, awaiting interactions, when to use .test() or play, portals, mocks, naming and file setup. Use when writing, fixing or reviewing a .stories.tsx file. Background knowledge that agents preload; not a command.
targets.intro: Apply these rules to every story file you write or review. The first section is always in force; open a rule from the table when the task touches it.

targets.title: Test data builder rules (TypeScript, mimicry-js)
targets.description: Rules for building test data in TypeScript with mimicry-js builders: explicit values for everything a test asserts on, .one() and .many() with overrides and traits, generator placement, fixed() for functions, resetting state. Use when creating or using a builder in a test or story. Background knowledge that agents preload; not a command.
targets.intro: Apply these rules whenever you create or use a builder in a TypeScript test or story.

targets.title: Test data factory rules (Python, factory_boy)
targets.description: Rules for building test data in Python with factory_boy: explicit values for everything a test asserts on, keyword overrides and Traits, build() versus create(), resetting sequences. Use when creating or using a factory in a Python test. Background knowledge that agents preload; not a command.
targets.intro: Apply these rules whenever you create or use a factory in a Python test.
